name: ISS (NASA public OEM) Data Source
description: Executable data-source (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no hostcalls but plugin.getConfig): request turns a TimerTick into the GET HttpRequest of NASA's public ISS ephemeris (CCSDS OEM KVN, config sourceUrl); hostcap/http-request fetches it; emit turns its HttpResponse into one SDS $OEM (verbose, explicit epochs; EME2000/UTC/EARTH as the file declares, NORAD 25544), consumed in memory by analysis/od.fit and never stored. A transport error, a status other than 200, an empty body or a file without state vectors fails closed. Nothing is stored, signed or published.

methods.description: A TimerTick -> one GET HttpRequest for the NASA ISS OEM (config sourceUrl, default NASA's public ISS.OEM_J2K_EPH.txt), for hostcap/http-request. The flow's trigger sets the cadence; the provider's suggested one is every 12 h (the former module timer iss-pull).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

inputPorts.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the NASA ISS OEM.

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the NASA ISS OEM.

methods.displayName: Parse the ISS OEM and emit $OEM
methods.description: The HttpResponse of the ISS OEM GET -> one $OEM.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the ISS OEM: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the ISS OEM: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One SDS $OEM ephemeris (verbose; EME2000/UTC as declared) for analysis/od.fit; never stored.

outputPorts.description: One SDS $OEM ephemeris (verbose; EME2000/UTC as declared) for analysis/od.fit; never stored.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one frame into the next request or the parsed ephemeris on the calling thread; the host parallelizes independent sources and this module creates no threads.
